usage: agentbreeder up [-h] [--environment ENVIRONMENT] [--port PORT]
                       [--no-browser] [--yes]
                       [dir]

positional arguments:
  dir                   A project with agent.yaml, stack.yaml

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
  --port PORT
  --no-browser
  --yes                 With DIR: confirm the grant and start its services
